evidence.instructions: Is the record honest about method: subgroup runs instead of one combined process, fresh fixture DBs per PG suite, environment-relative bench numbers, limitations section naming what is not verified? Any green-CI-alone release claim?

reliability.instructions: Any risk in the record itself: stale numbers that will rot, counts hardcoded against future suite growth, missing rerun triggers? Is the verdict correctly scoped to the candidate, not a standing release declaration?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the qualification record: product fixes, P13 work, ArtCraft transplants, billing changes? Are P13/AC-01/AC-02/AC-04 correctly left to the matrix and Issue #62?

security.instructions: Does the record weaken any control: hidden failure, downgraded advisory, omitted limitation, fixture DB used beyond scratch? Is the stale-database caveat stated so no one reruns suites the invalid combined way?
